title: Hearty Russian Sweet Potato Parfait
description: A hearty and comforting parfait combining the flavors of Russia and the sweetness of sweet potatoes. Perfect for a cold winter's day.
instructions: Mash the sweet potatoes in a bowl until smooth.
In a separate bowl, mix together the cottage cheese, diced apples, chopped walnuts, honey, vanilla extract, salt, and ground cinnamon.
Layer the sweet potato mixture at the bottom of a parfait glass or a tall clear cup.
Add a layer of the cottage cheese mixture on top of the sweet potatoes.
Repeat the layers one more time, ending with a layer of sweet potatoes on top.
Sprinkle the coconut flakes over the top of the parfait.
Chill in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes before serving.
